verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's own CHKit tool provides typed commands to describe, validate, test, and deploy schema and pipelines as code. The vendor explicitly positions it as 'infrastructure an agent can drive, in CI, with a diff you can review.' Unchanged native-protocol and HTTP client access also allows scripted, headless querying. Missing for 10: in-depth CHKit/CLI reference docs or CI pipeline examples, documented headless provisioning of clusters (API/IaC), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
